name: photo-relic-editorial
title_zh: 把真照片做成 Photo Relic
tagline_zh: 原片当文物，再做成编辑稿
desc_en: Create distinctive Photo Relic editorial artworks from user-provided photographs: preserve the real photo and pair it with a recognizable, artful abstract relic shaped like memory, modern printmaking, quiet Eastern restraint, and source-derived light. Use when the user asks to turn a photo into minimal art, photographic relic posters, abstract editorial photography, gallery-like photo posters, Dou
why_zh: 承认原片是文物，再做成编辑稿，不是滤镜打卡。
limit_zh: 要美颜、要瘦身、要网红棚拍感，会跟它的「文物」立场打架。
